snippet.title: Million To One - Game Instructions
snippet.description: Game Description: Welcome to Million To One! In this high-voltage free-for-all, you and your squad sprint through rapid-fire rounds, knocking out rivals as the field shrinks from a global mob to one lone victor. Think fast, play faster, and leave the wreckage behind.
